lines.text: Asaph cries aloud to God in his day of trouble, and his soul refuses to be comforted.
At night Asaph remembers his song and asks whether God's anger has shut off His power.
Asaph says the right hand of the Most High has changed, then resolves to remember the works of the LORD.
With power God redeemed the sons of Jacob and Abraham, and the waters saw Him and swirled.
God's path led through the sea, and He led His people like a flock by Moses and Aaron.
